remediation_patterns.title: Obsolete ALV Function Modules
remediation_patterns.reason: REUSE* ALV FMs removed in S/4HANA
remediation_patterns.before_code: CALL FUNCTION 'REUSE_ALV_LIST_DISPLAY' EXPORTING i_callback_program = sy-repid TABLES t_fieldcat = lt_fcat t_outtab = lt_data.
remediation_patterns.after_code: cl_salv_table=>factory( IMPORTING r_salv_table = lo_alv CHANGING t_table = lt_data ). lo_alv->display( ).

remediation_patterns.title: Pooled/Cluster Table Removal
remediation_patterns.before_code: SELECT * FROM vbddata INTO TABLE lt_data.
remediation_patterns.after_code: SELECT * FROM matdoc INTO TABLE lt_data WHERE ...

remediation_patterns.title: Removed Index Tables (BSIS, BSAS)
remediation_patterns.before_code: SELECT * FROM bsis INTO TABLE lt_bsis.
remediation_patterns.after_code: SELECT * FROM I_UniversalJournal INTO TABLE lt_bsis WHERE ...

remediation_patterns.title: CREATE OBJECT (obsolete instantiation syntax)
remediation_patterns.reason: Replaced by NEW operator in ABAP 7.40+
remediation_patterns.fix: Replace CREATE OBJECT with NEW operator

remediation_patterns.title: CALL METHOD (obsolete method call syntax)
remediation_patterns.reason: Replaced by functional method call syntax
remediation_patterns.fix: Replace CALL METHOD with direct functional call

remediation_patterns.title: SELECT * (non-selective field fetch)
remediation_patterns.reason: SELECT * is a performance anti-pattern; select only needed fields
remediation_patterns.fix: Specify only required fields in SELECT
remediation_patterns.before_code: SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_data.
remediation_patterns.after_code: SELECT carrid connid fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_data).

remediation_patterns.title: TRANSLATE statement (obsolete string operation)
remediation_patterns.fix: Replace TRANSLATE with to_upper( ) or to_lower( )
